text:
Is Elden Ring Nightreign crossplay? No.

PS4 and PS5 play together, Xbox One and Series X|S play together, and PC only plays with PC. Your progress doesn't carry over between them either.
alt: Elden Ring Nightreign: no crossplay. PS4 and PS5 together, Xbox One and Series X|S together, PC only with PC.

text:
Is Minecraft crossplay? Yes, if you're on Bedrock.

Bedrock plays across PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, Switch 2 and phones (you need a free Microsoft account). Java Edition only plays with other Java players.
alt: Minecraft: yes on Bedrock. Bedrock plays across everything, Java only with Java.

Is ARC Raiders crossplay? Yes.

PC (Steam and Epic), PS5 and Xbox Series X|S all play together, in mixed squads of three. Your progress and gear follow your Embark account, but you'd have to buy the game again on each platform.

text:
Is Stardew Valley crossplay? Only on computers.

Windows, Mac and Linux players on Steam, GOG and the Xbox app can share a farm. Consoles only play with the same console. Phones have a hidden, experimental way to join a PC farm.
alt: Stardew Valley: computers only. Windows, Mac and Linux farm together; consoles stay with their own kind.

text:
Is Fortnite crossplay? Yes, on every current platform.

PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, Switch 2, phones and cloud gaming all share lobbies. You can turn it off on PlayStation and Xbox, but not on Switch, PC or mobile.
alt: Every current platform, phones and cloud included. You can only opt out on PlayStation and Xbox.

text:
Is Terraria crossplay? Not yet, but it's close.

Re-Logic says Crossplay Phase One (update 1.4.6) is getting its finishing touches. Until then: PCs play together, phones play together, and each console family plays on its own.
alt: Crossplay Phase One is coming in 1.4.6. For now, each platform family plays on its own.

text:
Is Baldur's Gate 3 crossplay? Yes, since Patch 8.

PC, Mac, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S can share a party. Turn it on under Multiplayer → Cross-Play with a Larian account. Mods even work, as long as everyone has the same ones.
alt: Since Patch 8. Same mods for everyone and mods work in crossplay too.

text:
Is GTA Online crossplay? No.

PC, PlayStation and Xbox are all separate, and PS4 and PS5 players don't meet (same for Xbox One and Series X|S). On PC, Steam, Epic, Rockstar and Xbox app players do share sessions.
alt: No crossplay, and PS4/PS5 and Xbox One/Series X|S don't even meet each other.

text:
Is Palworld crossplay? Yes.

PC (Steam and Xbox app), Mac, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S all play together since v0.5.0. Your saves don't carry over between platforms, though.
alt: Every platform since v0.5.0. Saves don't carry over between platforms.

text:
Is Lethal Company crossplay? It doesn't need to be: it's PC-only on Steam, so everyone's on the same platform.

No console version has been announced, and the developer says one is unlikely before it leaves Early Access.
alt: It's only on Steam, so everyone's already on the same platform. No console version yet.

text:
Is Split Fiction crossplay? Yes.

PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Switch 2 can team up, and only one of you needs to own it thanks to the free Friend's Pass. Both players need an EA account.
alt: Only one of you needs to own it: the other joins free with the Friend's Pass.
